title: introduce-strided-kvcache-delta-sampler-and-mini-telemetry-export
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Existing KV cache samplers capture coarse hit/miss and age distributions but miss short-lived reuse patterns and interleaved-key churn that drive worst-case tail latency. This PR introduces a low-overhead strided sampling approach that observes per-key delta reuse distances (kvdeltas) and aggregates them into compact histograms, plus a lightweight "mini-telemetry" export for microbench dashboards. Motivation: help ops and SREs detect pathological access patterns (stride patterns, near-term reuse storms) without enabling heavy kernel tracing. Key changes: 1) runtime/kvcache/strided_sampler.cc/h: new sampler implementing a cross-thread strided sampling scheme. The sampler chooses a small set of candidate slots per epoch and records per-sample kvdelta (number of requests since last touch) as a 16-bit delta to a ring buffer. Sampling is non-blocking, uses atomic 32-bit packs to reduce contention, and supports per-tenant sampling rates. 2) runtime/kvcache/kvcache_metrics.cpp: adds kvdelta histogram aggregation (log-buckets), windowed resets, and an on-demand flush API used by the mini-telemetry exporter. 3) tools/microbench/replay_harness: a tiny trace replayer that can inject synthetic stride patterns and measure observed kvdelta distributions; includes a new test trace format and conversion tool. 4) observability/exporters/mini_telemetry_exporter: CSV + speedscope-friendly timeline exporter that maps sampler ring samples into micro-frames (10ms buckets) and emits a compact JSON artifact that dashboards ingest. 5) console/dashboard/annotations: a new dashboard panel for KV delta heatmaps and an integration point for the mini telemetry artifacts. 6) added unit tests and a microbench scenario under perf/benchmarks/kvcache_strided_test.cc with baseline and stressed configurations. Runtime flags: --kvcache-stride-sample= (controls stride size), --kvcache-sample-rate=

(probability), --mini-telemetry-dir= (emit path). Backwards compatibility: sampler is opt-in (disabled by default); no user-visible API changes. Performance: microbench numbers included in this PR show median overhead <0.8% and p99 overhead <2.5% on a 512-concurrency Llama-like workload when enabled at recommended rates. The sampler exposed several previously hidden patterns in internal traces: short reuse storms and interleaved-key eviction cascades; these were used to inform a subsequent change (ENG-1902) to prefetch heuristics. Test plan: unit tests for ring buffer correctness and atomic packing; integration test running trace replayer with known patterns; perf microbench run with and without sampler demonstrating low overhead. Artifacts: attached artifacts/strided_kv_report_2026-02-18.csv and artifacts/strided_kv_speedscope_2026-02-18.json (micro-frames). Checklist: - [x] strided sampler implementation + API - [x] histogram aggregation and flush - [x] microbench replay harness and synthetic traces - [x] exporter and dashboard panel wiring - [x] unit and perf tests - [x] docs: small note in docs/observability/kvcache.md - [x] e2e perf smoke in CI Related work: builds on earlier samplers and telemetry exporters but differs by focusing on kvdelta histograms and strided sampling to reduce correlation noise. Links: Linear ENG-1847 (kvcache telemetry spike), ENG-1902 (prefetch heuristic follow-up). CI: build, unit tests, lint, perf-microbench (artifact upload). Initial CI run: failed perf-microbench due to test flake (race in test harness); fixed by adding a tiny barrier in the replay harness. Final CI: all checks passed. Release notes: "Adds opt-in strided KV cache sampler and mini-telemetry export for KV delta histograms; opt-in runtime flags; no breaking changes."
commits: Add strided kvcache sampler and ring buffer (initial implementation)
Add kvdelta histogram aggregation and flush API
Add microbench replay harness and trace converter
Add mini-telemetry exporter and dashboard panel wiring
Unit tests and perf microbench scenarios
Docs note and small fixes after perf CI runs
review_comments: Diego: Can we avoid packing histograms on the hot path? Suggest we keep the ring buffer writes minimal and do bucketing on flush. Author: Ring writes store only 16-bit delta + 8-bit tag; bucketing moved to background flush thread.
Chen: Please add a stress test for atomic wrap-around on 64-bit counters. Author: Added kvcache_atomic_wrap_test and updated harness to simulate wrap conditions.
Sofia: Dashboard JSON schema needs a small change to accept microframe timestamps in ms. Author: Updated exporter to write ms timestamps and added schema version bump.
Diego: perf numbers look good. Approve after CI green.
Chen: small nits on header includes; fixed.
SRE (comment): When enabled at high sampling rates we saw a small memory bump; recommend adding a default cap. Author: added enforced default cap and documented expected memory usage in kvcache.md.
release_notes: Opt-in strided KV cache sampler to collect kv-delta histograms and a mini-telemetry exporter for microbench dashboards. Low-overhead; opt-in flags. Helpful for diagnosing short reuse storms and eviction cascades.
